# Benihana

> > Benihana is a legendary Japanese teppanyaki restaurant chain offering theatrical dining experiences and official branded merchandise.

Benihana National Corp. operates the iconic restaurant brand known for its teppanyaki-style cooking performances and Japanese cuisine. The company also offers official merchandise including chef accessories, apparel, and collectibles for fans of the dining experience.

## Key Topics

- Benihana
- Teppanyaki
- Japanese cuisine
- Restaurant merchandise
- Chef accessories
- Benihana National Corp.
- Chef hats and aprons
- Teppanyaki apparel
- Japanese restaurant gifts
- Benihana products
- Collectibles
- Dining experience
